text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We've coordinated both our 
training menu and my condition just for 
this day, haven't we?
choice_data_list:
Yes, we've built everything up for this 
very day.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Cherry blossoms suit the spring. Having 
endured the harsh winter, let us go and 
bloom in all our splendor.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I look forward to it.
Yeah, I'm really looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will not betray those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Kyah☆ Mayano's having sooo much fun~★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since you invited me on that 
whirlwind trip to Kyoto, I've been 
thinking~☆"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mayano, you've been so shiny lately ☆★ Did 
you find a brand new Marvelous!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Mm☆ I used to think all Twinkle Series 
races were pretty much the same, but...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"It's completely, totally different! So 
you've gotta focus too, Mavecchi☆"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I hear Brian-san was originally planning 
to run this Tenno Sho (Spring), too! 
That's why, you know..."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's so exciting and sparkly――and Maya and 
the others might be running in it someday 
too, right?
